messages:
emma_sales: Quick heads-up — Prospect (StateDept Solutions) wants Redwood deployed in AWS GovCloud (US) with a dedicated pool, 24/7 SLA, and a few bespoke DPA clauses. They need order form + signature routing clarified. PO will come from procurement (net30). Do we have a standard GovCloud orderform flow or should Legal take it directly? Also pricing: is there a GovCloud uplift on reserved capacity for dedicated pools? :thinking:

contracts-bot: Draft order form template created: https://redwood.internal/contracts/drafts/1850004321. Included GovCloud checkbox and PO fields. :page_with_curl:

javier_legal: I can pick up MSA/DPA review. Ask them to send the redlines PDF. For 24/7 SLA we need explicit incident definitions, MTTR objectives, and an uptime measurement method — don't promise RTO without SLOs. We should also add a fallback model variant clause for capacity shortages.

rachel_procurement: Routing notes: Finance needs the PO# on the orderform + vendor remit info. Their standard is net30; we can accept net30 for enterprise with credit check. Will need to map GovCloud billing to a separate accounting entity — I'll request a billing code, ETA 2 business days.

sam_eng: GovCloud dedicated pools are available but require provisioning lead time (approx 10 business days) + infra review for KMS/HSM. For a POC we can do a short-lived dedicated instance or run on our hosted region in GovCloud (non-prod). There is no automatic pricing uplift on the inference engine, but there is an infra surcharge for GovCloud certs and dual-tenant isolation — usually a one-time setup fee. Need expected qps for sizing.

emma_sales: They want a POC target of 500 qps bursts, steady 50 qps. Also asked: do quantization and batching options still apply in GovCloud ded pools? And can we sign an SOC/SOC addendum?

dmitri_secmgr: We can provide SOC2 report and a SOC addendum. For DPA redlines: we cannot accept clauses that request raw tensor dumps or unrestricted export of telemetry. KMS notes: if they insist on customer-managed CMKs in their GovCloud account, we need to validate cross-account key access — ops will need a brief runbook. Also require a scoping call for data residency controls.

javier_legal: Agreed on the DPA limits. If they send their security questionnaire (PDF/Confluence link) I'll mark acceptable vs. blockers and propose redline language. For SLA, propose Service Credits capped (e.g., % of monthly fees) and an exception for scheduled maintenance.

contracts-bot: Order form prefilled: \n```\nProduct: Redwood Dedicated (GovCloud)\nQuantity: reserved 10k q/mo baseline\nBilling: Net30 — PO# required\nSLA: 24/7 — draft to be reviewed by Legal\nBilling Entity: GOV-BILL-001 (placeholder)\n```\n
emma_sales: Attaching prospect email + initial DPA link: https://prospect.share/StateDept-DPA-redlines.pdf — forwarding now. Can we do a brief sync tomorrow EOD to align legal/procurement/eng on changes? @javier_legal @rachel_procurement @sam_eng :calendar:
